ActionItem.title: ActionItem
ActionItem.description: A follow-up task from a meeting decision. Backed by CalDAV VTODOs (ADR-002): this schema is a READ-ONLY OpenRegister projection over the user's action-item VTODOs (action-items-vtodo-deck-reconcile). Writes go through the Decidiq action-item endpoints / ActionItemWriter (OpenRegister TaskService), never ObjectService::saveObject.

decision.title: Decision
decision.description: Reference to the Decision this action item stems from (many-to-one).

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.description: Reference to the Meeting this action item stems from (many-to-one).

goal.title: Goal
goal.description: Optional reference to the organisation Goal (organisation-goals change) this action item serves. Round-trips through ActionItemWriter's generic non-core `fields` blob exactly like `decision`/`meeting` (goal is not in toTaskData()'s coreKeys): no PHP change (organisation-goals REQ-007, design D4). When set, this action item is counted in that Goal's declarative linkedActionItemCount/completedActionItemCount rollup.

AgendaItem.title: AgendaItem
AgendaItem.description: An item on a meeting agenda with type, time, and ordering

pausedDuration.title: Paused duration
pausedDuration.description: Minutes the agenda-item timer was paused for procedural interruptions, recorded separately from actualDuration (meeting-efficiency)

parentItem.title: Parent item
parentItem.description: UUID of the parent AgendaItem when this item is a nested sub-item (e.g. committee reports grouped under one heading). Null/absent for top-level items.

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.description: Reference to the Meeting this agenda item belongs to (many-to-one).

BoardEvaluation.title: BoardEvaluation
BoardEvaluation.description: One board self-evaluation cycle for a GovernanceBody (board-self-evaluation): anonymous member responses scored per-dimension and overall, materialised as scoreSummary on close, optionally published as an aggregate-only summary (raw responses are never published).

cycleLabel.title: Cycle label
cycleLabel.description: Human label for the evaluation cycle (e.g. a year), so past cycles remain distinguishable for trend comparison.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Evaluation cycle lifecycle: draft (roster/template being set) -> open (members submit anonymous responses) -> closed (scoring runs, scoreSummary materialised) -> published (optional; aggregate enters the public window). Per consume-or-rbac-authorization, only the body's chair or secretary may write this property.

openedAt.title: Opened at
openedAt.description: When the cycle was opened for responses.

closedAt.title: Closed at
closedAt.description: When the cycle was closed and scoring materialised.

invitedMemberCount.title: Invited member count
invitedMemberCount.description: Count of invited members (mirrors invitedParticipantIds length).

respondedCount.title: Responded count
respondedCount.description: Count of members who have submitted a response so far (mirrors respondedParticipantIds length). Tracked independently of response content so completion never de-anonymises an answer.

minRespondentThreshold.title: Minimum respondent threshold
minRespondentThreshold.description: Below this respondent count, per-dimension and free-text breakdowns are suppressed in scoreSummary (and thus never published) to prevent de-anonymisation by inference on a small body.

invitedParticipantIds.title: Invited participants (roster)
invitedParticipantIds.description: Participant UUIDs invited to this cycle. Completion-tracking roster ONLY: never linked to EvaluationResponse content, so non-responders can be reminded without de-anonymising any answer.

respondedParticipantIds.title: Responded participants (completion)
respondedParticipantIds.description: Participant UUIDs who have submitted a response. Set-membership only (has X responded, yes/no): carries no link to which EvaluationResponse belongs to which member.

chairUserId.title: Chair Nextcloud user id
chairUserId.description: Denormalised Nextcloud UID of the body's chair at cycle-creation time, consumed only by the lifecycle property's OpenRegister RBAC update rule (consume-or-rbac-authorization) so opening/closing a cycle is enforced by OR, not an app-local authorization service.

secretaryUserId.title: Secretary Nextcloud user id
secretaryUserId.description: Denormalised Nextcloud UID of the body's secretary at cycle-creation time, consumed only by the lifecycle property's OpenRegister RBAC update rule.

scoreSummary.title: Score summary
scoreSummary.description: JSON-encoded governance-specific scoring result (BoardEvaluationScoreService, REQ-AN-LEAF-002): overallScore always present; dimensionScores and themes are set to null and suppressed=true when respondedCount is below minRespondentThreshold, so no breakdown ever exists to leak, even internally, even to an admin. This is the one field exposed publicly (via publicationDate) when the body opts to publish; raw EvaluationResponse objects are never published.

publicationDate.title: Publication date
publicationDate.description: Publication date (WOO/governance transparency). When set in the past, scoreSummary (aggregate-only, already threshold-suppressed) is anonymously readable via the public-group RBAC rule (publicationDate <= $now). Set by ParticipationPublicationService::publishEvaluationResults() on publish opt-in.

depublicationDate.title: Depublication date
depublicationDate.description: Depublication date. When set in the past, the published summary is withdrawn from public access.

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: The governance body this evaluation cycle belongs to (many-to-one). Canonical property-level $ref relation (ADR-062 rule 7): the retired x-openregister-relations block declared this relation but materialised no property, so the reference had nowhere to live and no engine read it.

template.title: Evaluation template
template.description: The evaluation template this cycle instantiates (many-to-one). Canonical property-level $ref relation (ADR-062 rule 7).

BoardProxy.title: BoardProxy
BoardProxy.description: A proxy (volmacht) granted by one board member to another for a single meeting. This is the row ProxyVoteService writes through /api/proxies and the row the per-holder proxy cap counts; the signed-document side of a volmacht lives on ProxyAuthorization.

meetingIntegration.title: Meeting
meetingIntegration.description: Identifier of the meeting this proxy applies to. The per-holder cap is counted per meeting.

grantorIntegration.title: Grantor
grantorIntegration.description: Identifier of the participant delegating their vote (the volmachtgever).

holderIntegration.title: Holder
holderIntegration.description: Identifier of the participant receiving the delegation (the gevolmachtigde).

expiresAt.title: Expires at
expiresAt.description: Optional moment the delegation lapses. Empty when the proxy runs for the whole meeting.

proxyStatus.title: Proxy status
proxyStatus.description: Lifecycle state of the delegation. A freshly registered proxy starts pending-approval; only active proxies count toward the per-holder cap.

BudgetProposal.title: BudgetProposal
BudgetProposal.description: A project proposed for funding under a ParticipatoryBudget (p3-citizen-participation).

submitter.title: Submitter
submitter.description: Nextcloud UID or pseudonymous identifier of the citizen submitter.

participatoryBudget.title: Participatory budget
participatoryBudget.description: Reference to the ParticipatoryBudget this proposal belongs to (many-to-one).

CitizenPanel.title: CitizenPanel
CitizenPanel.description: A structured citizen advisory group with defined membership, term, and scope (p3-citizen-participation). Modelled as schema:Organization with classification 'citizen-panel' per Popolo.

description.title: Description
description.description: Public description of the panel's purpose and remit.

memberCount.title: Member count
memberCount.description: Current number of confirmed panel members.

createdBy.title: Created by
createdBy.description: Nextcloud UID of the staff member who created the panel.

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody that owns this citizen panel (many-to-one).

CitizenVote.title: CitizenVote
CitizenVote.description: A vote cast by a citizen, either on a motion (citizenVotingAllowed) or: in citizen-participation advisory mode, on a validated BudgetProposal. Distinct from staff Vote entities tied to a VotingRound; advisory citizen tallies are kept strictly separate from statutory VotingRound tallies. Version 0.2.0 added the proposalId field + proposal relation and relaxed motionId from required (a vote targets EITHER a motion OR a proposal).

voteValue.title: Vote
voteValue.description: Citizen vote value. For simple voting a string ('voor' | 'tegen' | 'onthoud'); for ranked voting an ordered array of option identifiers; for weighted voting a numeric weight or weight-map serialised as string.

voterId.title: Voter
voterId.description: Stable identifier for the citizen voter (Nextcloud UID or pseudonymous hash for anonymous referenda).

motionId.title: Motion
motionId.description: UUID of the Motion this vote applies to (omitted for budget-proposal advisory votes).

proposalId.title: Proposal
proposalId.description: UUID of the BudgetProposal this advisory vote applies to (citizen-participation). Mutually exclusive with motionId.

citizenPanelId.title: Citizen panel
citizenPanelId.description: Optional UUID of the CitizenPanel the voter represents; omitted for individual citizen votes.

weight.title: Vote weight
weight.description: Vote weight (for weighted voting; defaults to 1 for simple voting).

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Optional citizen-supplied reasoning attached to the vote (may be published with consent).

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Reference to the Decision (motion) this citizen vote concerns (many-to-one).

proposal.title: Proposal
proposal.description: Reference to the BudgetProposal this citizen vote concerns (many-to-one).

citizenPanel.title: Citizen panel
citizenPanel.description: Reference to the CitizenPanel this citizen vote was cast within (many-to-one).

ConflictOfInterest.title: ConflictOfInterest
ConflictOfInterest.description: A declared or detected conflict-of-interest disclosure per MCCG / governance code
ConflictOfInterest._authorizationNote: conflict-of-interest declared no schema-level authorization block, so its rule came from the decidesk register's baseline (which lists 'public' among the readers) rather than from anything this schema stated, on top of the confirmed IDOR in ConflictOfInterestController (conflict-of-interest-authorization-guard). These are sensitive personal declarations (financial interests, personal relationships), not public governance records, so this block states the rule explicitly: 'authenticated' only, no 'public'. NOTE on severity, measured 2026-08-20: anonymous callers get NOTHING from this instance's OpenRegister object API regardless of schema authorization — schemas that DO grant 'public' read (participatory-budget, public-consultation, board-evaluation) also return 0 rows anonymously — so this is making an implicit, incidental closure EXPLICIT, not closing an open door. ONLY 'read' is declared: OpenRegister's schema action vocabulary is CRUD (create/read/update/delete) and CLOSED by default — 'list' is NOT an action, and declaring it makes validateAuthorization() reject the schema, after which the importer SKIPS it while still reporting HTTP 200 'Configuration imported successfully'. That is exactly how an earlier revision of this block silently removed the 'decision' schema from a fresh instance and took the whole e2e seed down. Listing is governed by the read rule. (The REGISTER-level block does carry a 'list' key, harmlessly: registers store authorization as unvalidated JSON.) create/update are deliberately OMITTED: once a schema declares any authorization block, an omitted action is closed to everyone except the object owner and admin (PermissionHandler::resolveAuthorizationRaw/hasGroupPermission) — ConflictOfInterestService::declare()/recordAction() pass _rbac:false after enforcing the finer-grained per-object rule themselves (declaring member or chair/secretary; chair/secretary-only for recordAction — see the service class docblock), the same convention ProxyVoteService uses for proxy-authorization. delete is never performed by this app and stays closed to non-admins.

boardMember.title: Board member
boardMember.description: UUID of the board member or participant declaring the conflict of interest.

agendaItem.title: Agenda item
agendaItem.description: Optional UUID of the agenda item / resolution

declarationType.title: Declaration type
declarationType.description: The kind of interest declared (e.g. financial, personal, professional).

description.title: Description
description.description: Free-text description of the declared conflict of interest.

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: Assessed severity of the conflict, driving the required mitigating action.

actionTaken.title: Action taken
actionTaken.description: The mitigating action taken in response to the declaration (e.g. recusal, abstention).

declarationTimestamp.title: Declared at
declarationTimestamp.description: Timestamp when the conflict of interest was declared.

ConsultationReaction.title: ConsultationReaction
ConsultationReaction.description: A citizen reaction (idea, feedback) submitted on an open PublicConsultation (citizen-participation). Carries NO contact details or PII: the submitter is identified only by a Nextcloud UID (authenticated) or a pseudonymous token (anonymous). Soft-delete only so rejected reactions remain auditable.

publicationDate.title: Publication date
publicationDate.description: Publication date (WOO/DIWOO). Set by a moderator opt-in (publishReaction) on an approved reaction; the public-group RBAC rule then makes the reaction anonymously readable while publicationDate <= $now AND moderationStatus is approved.

depublicationDate.title: Depublication date
depublicationDate.description: Depublication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set in the past, the reaction is withdrawn from public access.

body.title: Reaction
body.description: The reaction text supplied by the citizen. Server-side size-capped.

moderationStatus.title: Moderation status
moderationStatus.description: Moderation state. Reactions enter as 'pending'; only 'approved' reactions are counted in the consultation's reactions relation and may be published.

submitterId.title: Submitter
submitterId.description: Nextcloud UID for authenticated submissions, or an opaque pseudonymous token for anonymous submissions. Never a name, email, or other contact detail.

moderationReason.title: Moderation reason
moderationReason.description: Optional staff-supplied reason recorded on approval or rejection.

voteCount.title: Vote count
voteCount.description: Idea-box and participatory-budget voting: number of citizen votes this reaction (idea / budget proposal) has received.

proposalTitle.title: Proposal title
proposalTitle.description: consultationType=participatory-budget: short title of the budget proposal (when this reaction is a budget proposal).

proposalAmount.title: Proposal amount
proposalAmount.description: consultationType=participatory-budget: requested amount for this budget proposal.

consultation.title: Consultation
consultation.description: Reference to the PublicConsultation this reaction was submitted to (many-to-one).

ContactDetail.title: ContactDetail
ContactDetail.description: A means of contacting a person or organization. Popolo: ContactDetail. Replaces the single email field on Participant with typed, multi-value contacts.

value.title: Value
value.description: Contact value e.g. email address (Popolo: value)

person.title: Person
person.description: Reference to the Person this contact detail belongs to (many-to-one).

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody this contact detail belongs to (many-to-one).

outcomeEmitted._note: `in` is not implemented for updated triggers. fieldChangeConditionMatches supports only `changed` and `equals`, and an unknown operator falls through to false — so this rule has never fired. Left declared rather than split into three near-identical rules: the scheduled path gained `in` in ConductionNL/openregister#2794, and bringing the same vocabulary to the updated path is the natural next step (the created-vs-updated-vs-scheduled convergence deferred there). Splitting now would only have to be undone then.

decisionPublished._note: Publication is the one Decision event that had NO declarative rule, while an imperative DecisionNotificationService::notifyOnPublish() sat beside it with zero callers, no tests and no DI registration — so nobody was ever notified that a decision had become public. ADR-031 keeps notifications declarative (gate-18 flagged the imperative class by name), so the rule lands here and the dead service is removed rather than wired up. isPublished is FLOW-OWNED: it only reaches 'public' through the guarded publication flow (PublicationEligibilityService::guardDirectPublicationWrite rejects a direct object write), so this trigger cannot be fired by an ordinary object update. Recipients mirror decisionProposed/decisionRecorded rather than inventing a third shape.

Decision.title: Decision
Decision._authorizationNote: decision declared no schema-level authorization block, so its read rule came from the decidesk register baseline rather than from anything this schema states. IntegrationController::getOutcome()'s docblock asserted that 'per-object read access is enforced by OpenRegister ObjectService RBAC'; that claim was unfounded precisely because this block was absent. This states the intended anonymous rule explicitly — only Decisions the app itself has published (isPublished === 'public') — leaving all others to authenticated callers, and mirrors ParticipatoryBudget / PublicConsultation / BoardEvaluation in this same file. Defence in depth only: the per-object controller guards added in signature-and-outcome-authorization-guard do not depend on it, and anonymous reads of this instance's object API return nothing regardless (measured 2026-08-20: schemas that DO grant 'public' read also return 0 anonymously). ONLY 'read' is declared: OpenRegister's action vocabulary is CRUD (create/read/update/delete) and CLOSED by default — 'list' is NOT an action, and adding it makes validateAuthorization() reject the schema, which the importer then silently SKIPS on an HTTP 200 'success'. Listing is governed by the read rule. create/update/delete are deliberately omitted — an omitted action is closed to everyone except the object owner and admin.
Decision.description: The universal governance-decision supertype (ADR-005). A single schema for every decision outcome: motion, amendment, resolution, contract, appointment, management point, policy and generic meeting outcome, distinguished by the required decisionType discriminator. Type-specific fields are folded in and revealed via progressive disclosure keyed on decisionType (ADR-006).

x-openregister.x-mail-security-audit: mailEnabled activates inbound email ingestion. Before production: verify OpenRegister sanitizes HTML/headers, validate sender identity, and ensure Decision views never use v-html for mail-sourced content. Tracked in issue #6.

Decision.x-decidesk-terminal-completeness: `outcome` and `decisionDate` are REQUIRED ONLY IN TERMINAL STATES (lifecycle decided | enacted | archived), never in flight (draft | proposed | deliberating | voting) and never for `withdrawn` — a withdrawn decision was never decided, so it has no adopted/rejected result. They are therefore NOT in required[] above, which would refuse to create any in-flight motion ('400 The required properties (decisionDate, outcome) are missing') and contradicts this schema's own lifecycle description: outcome is 'the voting result, set when reaching decided'. The rule is NOT expressed as JSON-Schema if/then because OpenRegister does not enforce conditional required — MEASURED, not assumed: Db/Schema.php has no if/then field, and Schema::getSchemaObject() rebuilds the validated schema object from the fixed key list title/description/version/type/required/$schema/$id/properties, so the block is discarded before the validator runs. A live in-memory probe against the installed OpenRegister confirmed an object with lifecycle=decided and no outcome/decisionDate validates TRUE under an if/then schema, while the same probe correctly rejects an unconditional missing required and an out-of-enum value. Enforcement instead lives at the transition boundary, where the state is actually entered: DecisionTransitionGuard::getMissingTerminalFields() + DecisionLifecycleService::resolveTerminalCompletenessRejection(). KNOWN GAP: a raw write straight to OpenRegister's object API bypasses that gate, exactly as it already bypasses the chair-only and quorum gates.

routeComplete.title: Route Complete
routeComplete.description: Whether every stage of this decision's route is decided or skipped. Materialised by OpenRegister on save from x-openregister-calculations. Never written by decidiq and never edited by hand.

decisionType.title: Decision type
decisionType.description: Discriminator selecting the kind of governance decision (ADR-005). The vocabulary is configuration, not code (decision-types-as-configuration): valid values are the entries of the decidiq decision_types app setting, seeded on install by SeedDecisionTypes and enforced referentially by DecisionTypeRegistry at the write path. Deliberately NO enum here: a declared enum drifts from the store and recreates the four-homes parity problem this change removed. Drives progressive disclosure of the type-specific field groups in the form. Per-type required fields (e.g. proposer for motion; resolutionNumber + voteThreshold for resolution; the amends relation for amendment) are enforced in the form/spec, not in this JSON-schema required[].

decisionDate.title: Decision date
decisionDate.description: When the decision was made. Absent while the decision is in flight (draft/proposed/deliberating/voting) and for a withdrawn decision; REQUIRED once the decision enters a terminal outcome state (decided/enacted/archived). See x-decidesk-terminal-completeness on this schema: the rule is enforced at the transition boundary, not in required[].

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: Decision outcome: the voting result. Orthogonal to `lifecycle`: an in-flight motion has NO outcome (leave the property absent rather than writing a placeholder such as 'pending', which is not in this enum), and a withdrawn decision never acquires one. REQUIRED once the decision enters a terminal outcome state (decided/enacted/archived). See x-decidesk-terminal-completeness on this schema.

isPublished.title: Publication state
isPublished.description: Publication state controlling citizen visibility. FLOW-OWNED (publish-decisions-via-opencatalogi): this field is a DERIVED OUTPUT of the public-publication flow, set to 'public' on publish, reset to 'internal' on withdraw, and is REJECTED when written directly through an OR object update outside that flow (PublicationEligibilityService:guardDirectPublicationWrite). 'internal' = staff-only; 'public' = published via the OR published-predicate / OpenCatalogi surface; 'confidential' = restricted access.

publishedAt.title: Published at
publishedAt.description: Publication timestamp. FLOW-OWNED (publish-decisions-via-opencatalogi): stamped by the publication flow on publish and cleared on withdraw; rejected on direct client writes alongside isPublished.

lifecycle.title: Status
lifecycle.description: Decision state-machine lifecycle (guarded transition map: draft → proposed → deliberating → voting → decided → enacted → archived, plus a terminal 'withdrawn' reachable from any non-terminal state before 'enacted'). The declarative transition map lives in x-openregister-lifecycle. Orthogonal to 'outcome' (the voting result, set when reaching 'decided') and 'isPublished' (citizen visibility of the record, p3-citizen-participation).

enactedAt.title: Enacted at
enactedAt.description: Timestamp when the decision entered the 'enacted' lifecycle state (set server-side by the enact transition).

motionType.title: Motion type
motionType.description: Revealed when decisionType=motion. Type of motion (folded from the retired Motion schema).

proposer.title: Proposer
proposer.description: Revealed when decisionType is motion, amendment or resolution. Name of the proposer (folded from Motion/Amendment/Resolution). Required for a motion decision (enforced in the form).

coSigners.title: Co-signers
coSigners.description: Revealed when decisionType=motion. List of co-signers (folded from the retired Motion schema).

submittedAt.title: Submitted at
submittedAt.description: Revealed when decisionType is motion or amendment. Submission timestamp (folded from Motion/Amendment).

citizenVotingAllowed.title: Citizen voting allowed
citizenVotingAllowed.description: Revealed when decisionType=motion. Whether citizens can participate in voting on this decision (p3-citizen-participation, folded from the retired Motion schema).

citizenVotingMethod.title: Citizen voting method
citizenVotingMethod.description: Revealed when decisionType=motion. Voting method rendered in the citizen voting UI (folded from the retired Motion schema). Only meaningful when citizenVotingAllowed is true.

proposedText.title: Proposed text
proposedText.description: Revealed when decisionType=amendment. Full proposed replacement text for the affected passage, diffed against the parent decision text in the amendment diff view (folded from the retired Amendment schema).

votingOrder.title: Voting order
votingOrder.description: Revealed when decisionType=amendment. Chair-assigned voting position among a motion's amendments (1 = voted first, most far-reaching). Folded from the retired Amendment schema.

resolutionNumber.title: Resolution number
resolutionNumber.description: Revealed when decisionType=resolution. Resolution number, format R-{year}-{seq} (folded from the retired Resolution schema). Required for a resolution decision (enforced in the form).

resolutionType.title: Resolution type
resolutionType.description: Revealed when decisionType=resolution. Resolution classification (renamed from Resolution.type to avoid collision with decisionType; folded from the retired Resolution schema).

voteType.title: Vote type
voteType.description: Revealed when decisionType=resolution. How the vote was conducted (folded from the retired Resolution schema).

voteThreshold.title: Vote threshold
voteThreshold.description: Revealed when decisionType=resolution. Majority rule applied when tallying (folded from the retired Resolution schema). Required for a resolution decision (enforced in the form).

fullText.title: Full text
fullText.description: Revealed when decisionType=resolution. Full resolution text (rich-text / HTML; folded from the retired Resolution schema).

background.title: Background
background.description: Revealed when decisionType=resolution. Background / motivation (rich-text; folded from the retired Resolution schema).

adoptionDate.title: Adoption date
adoptionDate.description: Revealed when decisionType=resolution. Date the resolution was adopted (folded from the retired Resolution schema).

effectiveDate.title: Effective date
effectiveDate.description: Revealed when decisionType=resolution. Date the resolution takes effect (folded from the retired Resolution schema).

targetBody.title: Target governance body
targetBody.description: Revealed when decisionType=appointment. Reference to the GovernanceBody the appointment is for (folded from the retired Voordracht schema's `body` field, renamed to avoid confusion with Decision's own `text`, which is the closest thing this schema has to a body-of-text field). Required for an appointment decision (enforced in the form).

targetPosts.title: Target posts
targetPosts.description: Revealed when decisionType=appointment. Zero or more references to the formal Post(s) the appointment targets (folded and pluralized from the retired Voordracht schema's single `post` field: the product decision requires one or more Posts). Optional.

targetRole.title: Target role
targetRole.description: Revealed when decisionType=appointment. The Membership role being appointed to (enum pinned to person-and-membership's Membership role enum; folded unchanged from the retired Voordracht schema's `targetRole` field). Required for an appointment decision (enforced in the form).

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.description: Revealed when decisionType=appointment. One or more structured candidates, each carrying either a Person reference or a free-text externalName for a not-yet-registered candidate (folded and translated from the retired Voordracht schema's `kandidaten` field). Required, minimum one entry, before an appointment decision can be proposed (enforced in the form, not in this JSON-schema required[]: matching the established per-type required-field pattern, e.g. motion's proposer).

person.title: Person
person.description: Reference to the candidate's Person record. Empty for an external candidate not yet registered: then externalName carries the name.

externalName.title: External name
externalName.description: Free-text name for a not-yet-registered candidate (typical for corporate RvC/RvT externals). Later linkable to a Person record without losing candidacy history.

nominatingParty.title: Nominating party
nominatingParty.description: Revealed when decisionType=appointment. The nominating party (voordragende partij) that made the nomination, structured: `type` is politicalGroup/body/person; `name` is the display name; `reference` optionally points at a resolved object (Person/GovernanceBody) when one exists (folded unchanged from the retired Voordracht schema's `nominatingParty` field).

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name of the nominating party (e.g. the fractie name).

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: Optional reference to a resolved object for the nominating party when one exists. Polymorphic: the sibling `type` names the target schema, person resolves against Person, politicalGroup/body against GovernanceBody, so a single $ref cannot express it without asserting one target for every row.

appointedMemberships.title: Appointed memberships
appointedMemberships.description: Revealed when decisionType=appointment. Server-set, nullable list of Membership objects materialized when this appointment decision is adopted. Declared here so the appointment field group is complete in one place; populated by the imperative Membership-materialization service shipped in the dependent change appointment-decision-type-membership (ADR-031 lifecycle-guard exception): this change ships no service code, so the field stays empty/absent until that dependent change lands.

sourceApp.title: Source app
sourceApp.description: The fleet app that raised this Decision via the integration hub (ADR-019 provenance). Populated by external app delegates; null for internally-created decisions.

subjectRegister.title: Subject register
subjectRegister.description: OpenRegister register of the originating object in the consuming app (provenance).

subjectSchema.title: Subject schema
subjectSchema.description: OpenRegister schema of the originating object (provenance).

subjectId.title: Subject
subjectId.description: UUID of the originating object in the consuming app (the back-reference).

subjectLabel.title: Subject label
subjectLabel.description: Human-readable label for the originating object shown in Decidiq list/detail (e.g. 'Lease contract 2027: pand X').

outcomeCallbackUrl.title: Outcome callback URL
outcomeCallbackUrl.description: Optional registry-validated callback URL for push delivery of the outcome. Validated against the ADR-019 integration registry consumer entry: arbitrary URLs are rejected (anti-SSRF).

externalReference.title: External reference
externalReference.description: Consumer's own reference for idempotency and ledger linking. The create-decision endpoint is idempotent on (sourceApp, subjectRegister, subjectSchema, subjectId, externalReference).

amends.title: Amends
amends.description: This decision modifies that decision. Used by decisionType=amendment to point at its parent motion decision (replaces the retired Amendment → Motion relation); more generally the legislative 'amends another decision' modification (Akoma Ntoso eId akn:amendment / ORI 'wijzigt'). Informational for effective-status purposes: an amended decision remains in force, just modified (design D1).

offer.title: Offers
offer.description: Contract attachment: offers/quotes related to a decisionType=contract decision (ADR-005).

order.title: Orders
order.description: Contract attachment: purchase orders related to a decisionType=contract decision (ADR-005).

route.title: Route
route.description: The ordered route of DecisionStage objects that this Decision travels. Empty when no staged route is configured; a stageless Decision is valid. The inverse relation (DecisionStage → Decision) is stored on DecisionStage.decision.

supersedes.title: Supersedes
supersedes.description: Decisions that this decision supersedes (replaces in their entirety): array of Decision references. Effect-bearing: a decision targeted by a decided/enacted supersedes becomes effectiveStatus=superseded (design D1/D2). Maps to Akoma Ntoso akn:replacement / ORI 'vervangt' / schema.org supersededBy (inverse).

repeals.title: Repeals
repeals.description: Decisions that this decision repeals (revokes / nullifies): array of Decision references. Effect-bearing: a decision targeted by a decided/enacted repeals becomes effectiveStatus=repealed (precedence over superseded; design D1/D2). Maps to Akoma Ntoso akn:repeal / ORI 'trekt in'.

implements.title: Implements
implements.description: Decisions that this decision implements / gives effect to (e.g. an executive decision implementing a council framework): array of Decision references. Informational; does not affect effective-status. Maps to Akoma Ntoso akn:implementation / ORI 'geeft uitvoering aan'.

refersTo.title: Refers to
refersTo.description: Decisions this decision merely references / relates to without modifying: array of Decision references. Informational; does not affect effective-status. Maps to Akoma Ntoso akn:cites / ORI 'verwijst naar' / schema.org isRelatedTo.

isUrgent.title: Urgent
isUrgent.description: Whether this decision has been declared urgent (spoedbesluit). Orthogonal to lifecycle/outcome/isPublished: no lifecycle state or transition is added. Additive optional field. Server-guarded: settable ONLY through the guarded urgency-trigger flow (UrgencyTriggerGuard, imperative seam A), rejected on a direct object update, the same field-guard posture as isPublished. Because saveObject is PUT-semantic, every decision write path MUST carry this forward.

urgencyReason.title: Urgency reason
urgencyReason.description: Free-text justification for the urgency declaration (the statutory/urgency basis, e.g. a Gemeentewet college spoedbevoegdheid or an articles-of-association urgent-resolution clause). CONDITIONALLY REQUIRED when isUrgent is true: enforced save-time by the trigger flow, not by a JSON Schema constraint (OR rejects allOf/anyOf/oneOf). Stored verbatim (length-validated on input, escaped on output). Defaults the emergency meeting's noticeDeviationReason.
urgencyReason.example: Acute opvangcrisis; eerstvolgende reguliere raadsvergadering is pas over drie weken (Gemeentewet-spoedbevoegdheid college).

urgencyDeclaredBy.title: Urgency declared by
urgencyDeclaredBy.description: Nextcloud user id of the actor who declared the urgency (resolved and stored by the trigger guard). Not a Person/participant reference: a uid string for audit attribution; no kind:field notification recipient references it (recipient rule).

urgencyDeclaredAt.title: Urgency declared at
urgencyDeclaredAt.description: Timestamp at which the urgency was declared (set by the trigger flow). Additive optional field.

citesGoverningDocuments.title: Cited governing documents
citesGoverningDocuments.description: Optional, additive: the canonical governing-document reference shape used by all consumers ({document, versie?, artikel?}). Lets a decision cite the governing-document article it is based on (e.g. a spoedbesluit citing the statuten article that permits urgency). The citation is assistive metadata: it MUST NOT block or gate any decision workflow, and it grants no read access to the cited document. The urgent-decision-procedure and vve-alv-pack siblings adopt this same shape; their wiring stays in those changes.

document.title: Governing document
document.description: Required reference to the cited GoverningDocument.

version.title: Governing document version
version.description: Optional reference to a specific sealed GoverningDocumentVersie. Omitted means 'the version in force at reading time' per the in-force resolution; a pinned versie gives the immutable-content guarantee.

article.title: Article
article.description: Optional plain-string article reference, e.g. 'art. 14 lid 3'.

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.description: Optional reference to the Meeting this decision was taken in. Written by MeetingDecisionsTab.vue when a decision is created from a meeting's decisions tab. Empty for decisions created outside a meeting flow (e.g. a citizen-panel or nomination decision).

agendaItem.title: Agenda item
agendaItem.description: Optional reference to the AgendaItem this decision resolves. Written by AgendaMotionsTab.vue when a decision (motion) is created from an agenda item's motions tab. Empty for decisions not tied to a specific agenda item.

transitions._note: Decide-without-vote: DecisionTransitionGuard only permits this edge in domains whose policy sets allowDecideWithoutVote (operations, citizen); every other domain, and the default-deny fallback, rejects it before the save reaches OR.

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative guarded transition map (ADR-031). The proven 7-state flow draft → proposed → deliberating → voting → decided → enacted → archived is retained from decision-state-machine-v1; a terminal 'withdrawn' state is added, reachable from any non-terminal state before 'enacted' (design D2 + resolved deferred question). lifecycle is orthogonal to 'outcome' (voting result) and 'isPublished' (citizen visibility). This map mirrors DecisionTransitionGuard::TRANSITIONS (the guard filters edges per governance domain on top of it; DecisionTransitionMatrixTest pins the parity): deliberating→decided is the guarded decide-without-vote edge, decided→archived archives a decision that was never enacted (a rejected outcome cannot enact).

routeComplete.description: True when all stages are decided or skipped (route fully resolved). False when stageCount is 0 (no route configured). Declarative per ADR-031 (D4).

Decision.x-decidesk-routeComplete-note: routeComplete is materialise: true, so OpenRegister PERSISTS it on save rather than computing it on read: CalculationOnSaveListener patches it into the payload before persistence, and RenderObject::applyVirtualCalculations() skips it for exactly that reason. A materialised value only survives if the schema DECLARES the property, because MagicMapper::prepareObjectDataForTable() is a whitelist by omission over the declared properties, with no JSON blob column to fall back on. It was not declared, so it was discarded on every write, 60 times in one install. It is declared under properties now, and nothing in decidiq writes it: the listener is the only legitimate writer. Two things also had to change for the value to be right rather than merely stored. The counts are declared a second time under x-openregister-aggregate-refs, because CalculationPayloadBuilder::build() resolves ONLY that key and injects each result as @aggregate.<name>, while x-openregister-aggregations is the reporting annotation AggregationController serves. Referencing the reporting names as bare props made each one null, so `null > 0` was false, the `and` short-circuited, and routeComplete was false on every decision whatever its route. Note `filters` (plural) in aggregate-refs against `filter` (singular) in aggregations: AggregateReferenceResolver::resolveOne() reads spec['filters']. And the sum operator is `+`; `add` is not in CalculationEvaluator's table and would have thrown Unknown operator.
Decision.x-decidesk-currentStage-note: currentStage WAS declared as a materialised calculation over a `firstRelated` operator. No such operator exists: CalculationEvaluator's match falls through to `throw new EvaluationException(Unknown operator)`, CalculationOnSaveListener caught it and carried on, and the field never materialised on any decision. This is the same wall x-decidesk-effectiveStatus-note describes below, and it takes the same answer: the evaluator has no relation-traversal operator, so the first unresolved stage is derived where the route is read, from the DecisionStage rows the route UI already loads. Restore a calculation here only once OpenRegister ships a relation operator, and reference the counts as @aggregate rather than bare props.
Decision.x-decidesk-effectiveStatus-note: DESIGN D2 — effectiveStatus is NOT a declarative calculation. OpenRegister's CalculationEvaluator (openregister/lib/Service/Calculation/CalculationEvaluator.php) supports only scalar/arithmetic/date operators (prop, and, or, eq/ne/lt/lte/gt/gte, +, -, *, /, %, concat, if, now, diffDays, formatDate, dateDiff) — it has NO inverse/reverse-relation operator. The inbound 'which decided/enacted decision supersedes/repeals this one' lookup cannot be expressed as a materialised calculation. Per design D2 fallback, effectiveStatus is derived CLIENT-SIDE in RelatedDecisionsTab.vue + DecisionRouteTab.vue: query decisions whose supersedes/repeals array contains this id, filter to lifecycle in {decided, enacted}, precedence repealed > superseded > lifecycle.

DecisionStage.title: DecisionStage
DecisionStage.description: One step in a Decision's route: an ordered stage owned by a named decision-maker (Person or GovernanceBody) with its own status lifecycle, outcome, and method. Implements the ambtelijk → politiek bridge described in ADR-005/ADR-006/ADR-031 (design D1). C5 (decision-methods) expands the method enum; C6 builds the route UI.

sequence.title: Sequence
sequence.description: 1-based ordinal position of this stage in the decision route. Stages are processed in ascending sequence order.

mandatory.title: Mandatory
mandatory.description: Whether this stage must be taken. COPIED from the ApprovalRoute step at instantiation, deliberately: reading it from the route at decision time would give a different answer whenever the template changed after a subject started travelling it.

stageType.title: Stage type
stageType.description: Functional type of this stage: determines the role it plays in the route. `endorsement` is the parafering case: a sign-off that is not itself the decision.

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle state of the stage. Carries x-openregister-lifecycle transitions (ADR-031): pending → active → decided; pending → skipped; active → skipped. 'decided' and 'skipped' are terminal.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: Decision outcome recorded when status=decided. Null when status is pending/active/skipped. `returned` is the sign-off case and behaves unlike the rest: it re-opens an EARLIER stage rather than ending this one, which is why `rejected` and `deferred` could not express it, both end a stage and neither reopens one.

decidedAt.title: Decided at
decidedAt.description: Timestamp when the stage reached status=decided. Null when status is not decided.

method.title: Method
method.description: Method by which the stage is resolved. Coarse enum: the vote sub-variants (secret/personal/general) are configured on the linked VotingRound, not via additional method values (C5 decision-methods D1). The mechanism relation required by the active method MUST be populated: vote⇒votingRound, chair-register⇒registeredBy, signature⇒signedDocument; advice and manual require no mechanism relation (C5 D2 validation note). Defaults to manual.

decisionMakerType.title: Decision-maker type
decisionMakerType.description: Discriminator indicating whether the assignee is an individual person (person) or a governance body (body). Must be consistent with exactly one of assignedPerson or assignedBody being populated.

label.title: Label
label.description: Human-readable label for the stage, displayed in the route timeline.

note.title: Note
note.description: Free text recorded by the stage owner at decision time: e.g. reasoning, conditions, or dissenting remarks.
note.example: Unaniem advies uitgebracht na bespreking in commissie.

decision.title: Decision
decision.description: The parent Decision this stage belongs to. Required: every stage must be owned by exactly one Decision.

assignedPerson.title: Assigned person
assignedPerson.description: Individual decision-maker for this stage. Populate when decisionMakerType=person; leave null when decisionMakerType=body. Exactly one of assignedPerson/assignedBody must be populated, consistent with the decisionMakerType discriminator (design D2).

assignedBody.title: Assigned body
assignedBody.description: Group decision-maker for this stage. Populate when decisionMakerType=body; leave null when decisionMakerType=person. Exactly one of assignedPerson/assignedBody must be populated, consistent with the decisionMakerType discriminator (design D2).

votingRound.title: Voting round
votingRound.description: The VotingRound that resolves this stage. Required when method=vote; the stage outcome is derived declaratively from VotingRound.result (C5 D2/D4). Leave null for method≠vote. Vote sub-variants (secret/personal/general) are configured on the VotingRound (isSecret, votingMethod) rather than by expanding the method enum (C5 D1).

registeredBy.title: Registered by
registeredBy.description: The chair who recorded the outcome directly for this stage. Required when method=chair-register; leave null for other methods. The chair sets outcome + decidedAt directly; registeredBy records who (C5 D2).

signedDocument.title: Signed document
signedDocument.description: The signed DigitalDocument produced for this stage. Required when method=signature; leave null for other methods. Signatories are read from the related Minutes.signedBy. EIDASSignatureService resolves this stage (sets outcome=adopted + decidedAt) when eIDAS signing completes (C5 D2/D3/D5).

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative guarded transition map (ADR-031 / design D4). Terminal states 'decided' and 'skipped' mirror the route-progress aggregation on Decision: a stage is resolved when it reaches either terminal state. The 'active' state marks the currentStage (derived declaratively on Decision via x-openregister-calculations).

DecisionStage.x-decidiq-outcome-note: `outcome` is written by code, not derived by a calculation, and this schema deliberately declares no x-openregister-calculations. Three separate facts rule a calculation out. RenderObject::applyVirtualCalculations() assigns its result unconditionally, so a virtual calculation named after a stored property replaces that property on every read, and the only expression that would hand the stored value back ({"prop": "outcome"}) is a self-reference CalculationAnnotationValidator rejects as a cycle. CalculationOnSaveListener writes a materialised value whenever it differs from the stored one, null included, so materialise: true would clear every outcome an actor recorded. And the virtual read path builds its payload with @self only, never @ref or @aggregate, so a materialise: false calculation cannot read VotingRound.result across the votingRound relation at all. VotingRoundCloser::resolveDecisionStage() therefore records the vote outcome when the round closes: adopted to adopted, rejected and tied to rejected, invalid to no outcome. Every other method sets it directly: ApprovalRouteService for the route verbs, the chair for chair-register, EIDASSignatureService for signature.

Deliberation.title: Deliberation
Deliberation.description: A threaded discussion forum container linked to a motion or topic for structured citizen deliberation (p3-citizen-participation). Individual posts are conceptually schema:DiscussionForumPosting children stored as related objects.

relatedMotion.title: Related motion
relatedMotion.description: Optional UUID of the Motion under deliberation.

moderator.title: Moderator
moderator.description: Nextcloud UID of the staff moderator.

postsCount.title: Posts count
postsCount.description: Number of posts in the thread.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Reference to the Decision (motion) this deliberation concerns (many-to-one).

EngagementRecord.title: EngagementRecord
EngagementRecord.description: A record of participant engagement during a meeting: speeches, questions raised, and topics suggested

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.description: UUID of the linked Meeting object

participant.title: Participant
participant.description: UUID of the linked Participant object

speeches.title: Speeches
speeches.description: Speech events recorded for this participant

engagementScore.title: Engagement score
engagementScore.description: Governance-specific engagement score (0–100), computed in-app by EngagementService.calculateScore() and stored on each capture

EngagementRecord.x-decidiq-engagement-counts-note: speechCount, questionCount and topicCount are deliberately not declared as calculations. No operator counts the entries of an array: the vocabulary CalculationEvaluator implements has neither size nor length, and an aggregate-reference counts objects of another schema rather than entries in an inline array on this one. The code that knows the answer already has it: EngagementService::applyEvent() appends the entry and calculateScore() counts all three in the same call, storing the result in engagementScore. If a reader ever needs the counts on their own they belong here as declared integer properties written by that service, not as a calculation.

EvaluationResponse.title: EvaluationResponse
EvaluationResponse._authorizationNote: evaluation-response declared no schema-level authorization block, so it fell back to the decidesk register baseline and every raw board self-evaluation answer was readable by ANY authenticated user through OpenRegister's generic object API. That does not de-anonymise anyone — this schema carries no member relation and its responseToken is a server-secret HMAC — but it defeats the DELIBERATE anonymity threshold on the aggregate: BoardEvaluation suppresses dimensionScores and themes (suppressed=true) when too few members responded, precisely so a small board cannot be read individually, while the underlying answers stayed open to the whole instance. You could not learn WHO said it; you could read WHAT was said in a cycle whose summary was withheld for exactly that reason. Declaring a block with 'read' OMITTED closes it to everyone except the response's own author and admins. BoardEvaluationScoreService::closeCycle() therefore reads the set with `_rbac: false` — the caller is already authorised by BoardEvaluationAccessGuard::requireChairOrSecretary(), and a chair does not own the other members' responses, so under caller RBAC the query would return nothing and the cycle would close with a vacuous score summary on a healthy 200. NOTE: only CRUD actions (create/read/update/delete) are valid here — 'list' is NOT an action and makes validateAuthorization() reject the schema, after which the importer silently SKIPS it on an HTTP 200 'imported successfully'.
EvaluationResponse.description: One member's anonymous submission to a BoardEvaluation cycle (board-self-evaluation). Carries NO member relation and no participant identity anywhere in its content: anonymity is inherited from the existing secret-ballot mechanism (opaque HMAC dedup token only, same as VotingService's secret-round voterToken). Completion is tracked separately on BoardEvaluation.respondedParticipantIds, never here.

answers.title: Answers
answers.description: One entry per answered question. No member identity anywhere in this array or object.

dimension.title: Dimension
dimension.description: Denormalised from the template question, for scoring convenience.

likertValue.title: Likert value
likertValue.description: Answer value for a likert question (within the question's scaleMin/scaleMax).

freeText.title: Free text
freeText.description: Answer text for a free-text question.

responseToken.title: Response token
responseToken.description: Opaque HMAC(participantId + ':' + evaluationId, server-side secret) dedup token, reuses the same secret-ballot mechanism VotingService uses for secret VotingRounds (app config key 'voter_token_secret'). One-way: cannot be inverted to recover the participant id without the server-side secret. Used only for idempotent one-response-per-member enforcement, never for read display or identity resolution.

boardEvaluation.title: Board evaluation
boardEvaluation.description: The evaluation cycle this response belongs to (many-to-one). Canonical property-level $ref relation (ADR-062 rule 7). Links the response to the CYCLE only: never to a participant, preserving the secret-ballot guarantee.

EvaluationTemplate.title: EvaluationTemplate
EvaluationTemplate.description: A reusable, dimension-organised question set for a board self-evaluation (board-self-evaluation). Templates are editable and reusable across GovernanceBody objects and evaluation cycles.

title.title: Title
title.example: Board effectiveness self-evaluation (NL Corporate Governance Code)

description.title: Description
description.description: Purpose and intended use of the template.

dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.description: Board-effectiveness dimensions this template's questions are organised by.

questions.title: Questions
questions.description: Ordered question set. Each question declares the dimension it measures, its prompt, and its type (likert or free-text). Reusable across bodies and cycles.

id.title: Question id
id.description: Stable slug referenced by EvaluationResponse.answers[].questionId (survives template edits that reorder questions).

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The question text shown to the responding member.

scaleMin.title: Scale minimum
scaleMin.description: Lower bound of the Likert scale (type=likert only).

scaleMax.title: Scale maximum
scaleMax.description: Upper bound of the Likert scale (type=likert only).

GovernanceBody.title: GovernanceBody
GovernanceBody.description: A governance body (council, board, committee, assembly)

quorumRule.title: Quorum rule
quorumRule.description: How a quorum is CALCULATED (e.g. majority). Not how many members are required: that is `quorum`, which is a number. A calculation method cannot express a statutory minimum member count.

quorum.title: Quorum (members)
quorum.description: How MANY members are required for a valid sitting. Not how a quorum is calculated: that is `quorumRule`. Deliberately has NO default: an unset value means 'not specified', and a default of 0 would assert that no members are needed. Awb 7:13 objection advisory committees state this as a number.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether this body may be assigned new work. Independent of termStart/termEnd: a body can sit inside its term and be suspended, or be past its term and still finishing open cases, so availability cannot be derived from the dates. Unrelated to the schema-level x-openregister.active flag, which says nothing about an individual body.

jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction
jurisdiction.description: The territorial or subject-matter competence of this body.

statutoryBasis.title: Statutory basis
statutoryBasis.description: The legal instrument this body is constituted under (e.g. 'Awb 7:13', a local verordening). Free text on purpose: a closed vocabulary drawn from one country's law cannot express the instruments behind bodies in another, and a caller forced to pick from a list that does not fit will pick a wrong value.

hourlyRate.title: Hourly rate
hourlyRate.description: Average hourly rate in EUR per attendee, used by the meeting cost calculator (meeting-efficiency). Schema.org MonetaryAmount value; currency is EUR.

transcriptRetentionPolicy.title: Transcript retention policy
transcriptRetentionPolicy.description: Per-body retention policy for meeting recordings and raw transcripts after the meeting's minutes are approved (meeting-transcription). 'keep' retains everything; 'delete-recording' removes only the audio recording; 'delete-both' removes the recording and the raw transcript file. Enforced by the TranscriptRetentionJob.

transcriptRetentionDays.title: Transcript retention days
transcriptRetentionDays.description: Number of days after minutes approval before the retention policy is enforced for this body's recordings/transcripts (meeting-transcription). Default 30.

parentBody.title: Parent body
parentBody.description: Reference to the parent GovernanceBody this body belongs to: used for factions (bodyType=faction) referencing their council, and generically available for other sub-body hierarchies. Optional.

processTemplate.title: Process template
processTemplate.description: Identifier of the default process template assigned to this body (built-in catalogue id, e.g. standard-decision; becomes an OR object reference once the process-configuration capability ships template objects). Applies when no specialized template is chosen for a decision.

additionalTemplates.title: Additional templates
additionalTemplates.description: Identifiers of specialized process templates available to this body for specific decision types (e.g. statute-amendment, board-election), in addition to the default processTemplate.

GovernanceReport.title: GovernanceReport
GovernanceReport.description: A generated annual governance report for one board and year (meeting/resolution counts, vote tally, independence ratio, attendance rate, conflict count and the compliance flags derived from them). This is the row GovernanceReportingService persists so /api/governance-reports/{id} and /{id}/export/{format} have something to address.

boardIntegration.title: Board
boardIntegration.description: Identifier of the governance body the report covers.

meetingCount.title: Meeting count
meetingCount.description: Number of meetings held in the reporting year.

resolutionCount.title: Resolution count
resolutionCount.description: Number of resolutions taken in the reporting year.

voteTally.title: Vote tally
voteTally.description: Votes cast in the reporting year, counted per outcome (in-favor, against, abstain, absent, recused-due-to-conflict).

memberCount.title: Member count
memberCount.description: Number of board members in the reporting year.

independenceRatio.title: Independence ratio
independenceRatio.description: Share of board members classified as independent.

attendanceRate.title: Attendance rate
attendanceRate.description: Share of possible member-meeting attendances actually recorded.

conflictCount.title: Conflict count
conflictCount.description: Number of conflict-of-interest declarations in the reporting year.

flags.title: Compliance flags
flags.description: Compliance verdict for the report: whether every threshold passed, plus the list of thresholds that did not.

message.en: {{title}} is starting in Decidiq. Open it?

Meeting.title: Meeting
Meeting.description: A scheduled governance meeting with agenda, participants, and lifecycle

quorumPercentage.title: Quorum Percentage
quorumPercentage.description: Share of the governance body present at this meeting, as a percentage. Materialised by OpenRegister on save from x-openregister-calculations. Never written by decidiq.

quorumWith.title: Quorum Met
quorumWith.description: Whether the meeting met its quorum, true when no quorum is required. Materialised by OpenRegister on save from x-openregister-calculations. Never written by decidiq.

actionItemCompletionRate.title: Action Item Completion Rate
actionItemCompletionRate.description: Share of this meeting's action items that are completed, as a percentage. Materialised by OpenRegister on save from x-openregister-calculations. Never written by decidiq.

meetingType.title: Meeting type
meetingType.description: The kind of meeting (e.g. regular, committee, public hearing).

governanceBody.title: Body
governanceBody.description: The governance body or team this meeting belongs to. Materialises the governanceBody relation as a real property so per-body meeting filters and the participant-count aggregations (which filter on @self.governanceBody) resolve.

scheduledDate.title: Start date
scheduledDate.description: Date and time the meeting starts.

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Date and time the meeting ends.

location.title: Location
location.description: Physical address or video-conference link for the meeting.

meetingMode.title: Attendance mode
meetingMode.description: How participants attend: in person, digital, or hybrid.

quorumRequired.title: Quorum override
quorumRequired.description: Optional per-meeting override of the minimum participants required. Defaults to the meeting type's quorum.

seriesPattern.title: Recurrence pattern
seriesPattern.description: Recurrence pattern stored on the series template meeting (meeting-series). Expanded into individual meeting instances by MeetingSeriesService.

interval.title: Interval
interval.description: Step between occurrences in frequency units (>= 1)

until.title: Until
until.description: Inclusive end date of the series

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.description: Dates (Y-m-d) on which no instance is generated

eventAttendanceMode.title: Attendance mode (schema.org)
eventAttendanceMode.description: Schema.org attendance mode, derived from the attendance mode field; not edited directly.

virtualLocation.title: Video-conference link
virtualLocation.description: Deprecated: use Location. Hidden from the form; retained for existing data.

chair.title: Chair
chair.description: UUID of the Participant who chairs this meeting. Resolved to the Participant record in MCP and minutes generation; the chair field on the Participant (role=chair) applies to the governance body broadly, while this field overrides the chair for this specific meeting.

isPublic.title: Public
isPublic.description: Staff INTENT flag (publish-decisions-via-opencatalogi): marks that this meeting is intended for public visibility. It is a precondition for AGENDA publication eligibility (true + convocation sent), NOT itself a publication action: anonymous visibility happens only when staff explicitly publish the derived agenda payload via the public-publication flow. When true, the agenda (if published), recordings, and approved minutes become eligible for citizen visibility.

submissionDeadline.title: Submission deadline
submissionDeadline.description: Deadline for submitting motions and amendments for this meeting (motion-amendment spec). Empty = no deadline. Motion/amendment creations after this moment are rejected server-side by the SubmissionDeadlineListener.

openedAt.title: Opened at
openedAt.description: Timestamp of the first 'open' lifecycle transition, stamped server-side by MeetingService (meeting-efficiency). Basis for the live cost calculator and duration analytics. NOT readOnly: OpenRegister reads readOnly as immutable-after-create and rejects the UPDATE for every writer, including MeetingService itself, a meeting is created before it is opened, so a readOnly stamp can never be written.

closedAt.title: Closed at
closedAt.description: Timestamp of the 'close' lifecycle transition, stamped server-side by MeetingService (meeting-efficiency). NOT readOnly: see openedAt: readOnly made every opened -> closed transition fail with 'Cannot modify readOnly property: closedAt' (422).

meetingCost.title: Meeting cost
meetingCost.description: Total meeting cost in EUR, computed server-side on close from elapsed time x attendee count x the governance body's hourlyRate (meeting-efficiency). Schema.org MonetaryAmount value. NOT readOnly: see openedAt: it is stamped on close, i.e. always after create.

shortenedNotice.title: Shortened notice
shortenedNotice.description: True when this extraordinary meeting's convocation was deliberately sent below the body's regular notice period (noticePeriodDays) for an urgent decision. Additive optional field; exclusive to meetingType=extraordinary (enforced save-time). The pre-send overdue hint (noticeRules) presents a recorded deviation as a deliberate shortened-notice state, not an error.

actualNoticeHours.title: Actual notice (hours)
actualNoticeHours.description: The notice actually given, in hours, at convocation send time. Recorded on a shortened-notice deviation. The send is rejected save-time when this is below the governing body's urgencyPolicy.minimumNoticeFloorHours (Task 6, hour-granular floor sitting below the day-granular notice period).

noticeDeviationReason.title: Notice deviation reason
noticeDeviationReason.description: Reason the regular notice period could not be met. CONDITIONALLY REQUIRED when shortenedNotice is true (enforced save-time, not by a schema constraint), defaulting to the linked urgent decision's urgencyReason.
noticeDeviationReason.example: Spoedbesluit noodopvang — reguliere oproeptermijn niet haalbaar.

Meeting.x-decidesk-materialised-quorum-note: Three materialised calculations here were discarded on every write and two of them are read in anger: MeetingTransitionGuard gates a transition on `quorumWith` and treats an absent value as false, and GovernanceHealthWidget filters out every meeting whose `quorumPercentage` is undefined, so the widget was always empty. Same mechanism as x-decidesk-routeComplete-note on Decision, in all three parts. MagicMapper::prepareObjectDataForTable() is a whitelist by omission over the DECLARED properties, so a materialised value with no property declaration is stored nowhere; the three are declared under properties now. CalculationPayloadBuilder::build() resolves only x-openregister-aggregate-refs and injects it as @aggregate.<name>, so the participant and action-item counts are declared there too and referenced that way, instead of as bare props that evaluated to null. And the operators are `*` and `/`: `mul` and `div` are not in CalculationEvaluator's table and threw Unknown operator, which the listener caught and swallowed. `quorumRequired` stays a bare prop because it is a real declared property.

PublicationPayload.title: PublicationPayload
PublicationPayload.description: Derived, immutable public payload (publish-decisions-via-opencatalogi). Constructed ALLOW-LIST style by PublicationPayloadService: one polymorphic shape discriminated by oriType (Besluit / Vergadering / Verslag). Carries OpenRaadsinformatie-mapped fields alongside schema.org annotations so OpenCatalogi/OR public-API consumers receive ORI-compatible data without a bespoke harvester. By construction this schema contains NO UID fields, NO contact details, NO individual vote records, and NO voter identities: decision payloads carry vote TOTALS only, agenda payloads omit confidential items, minutes payloads render attendance per the body's policy. Anonymous visibility is governed by the OpenRegister RBAC published-predicate: the authorization.read rule grants the public group read access when publicationDate <= $now; publishing sets publicationDate on the payload instance, withdraw sets depublicationDate. The live source object is never published.
